scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "PORT=5001 npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.stg: concurrently "npm run stg --prefix frontend" "PORT=5002 npm run stg --prefix backend"
scripts.prod: concurrently "npm run prod --prefix frontend" "PORT=5003 npm run prod --prefix backend"
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:development --prefix backend && npm run build:development --prefix frontend
scripts.build:stg: npm run build:staging --prefix backend && npm run build:staging --prefix frontend
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:production --prefix backend && npm run build:production --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix frontend" "npm run start --prefix backend"
